note: Operator feedback on dot actions (dot-feedback.ts DOT_FEEDBACK_PATH); feeds later wakes' prompts. MSN-STORE-BOUNDS-2: readers scan backward to the 30-day feedback window (readJsonLinesSince); the writer keeps a 37-day time window at write time (DOT_FEEDBACK_RETENTION_MS, min 8 MiB) and archives dropped rows to <store dir>/compaction-archive/. No reader looks past 30 days, so nothing a reader uses is lost. The janitor never rewrites it.
